Sofia, Pellucid Harbor Logistics is Kwame Adjei-Rowe's account, so send the ticket to him. He took it over on Nov 22, 2025, and nothing has changed since. Bettina said in this channel on Oct 14 that Pellucid stays with Kwame. She had first written Pellucid, then corrected it to say she was covering Pellow.

The "PHL" shorthand covers two accounts. Pellow Home Living is the Mid-Atlantic home goods account, and Bettina is covering it while you're at Hagerstown. Pellucid is the Gulf Coast terminal account. If the ticket mentions Gulf Coast or terminal gate rows, it's Pellucid and goes to Kwame. If it's the home goods account, it's Pellow.
